parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the associated product. You must use an instance that the invoker has permission to access and that actually exists. It must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the conversation scenario under the instance. Specify an existing scenario. Subsequent conversations and end requests for the same text session must use the scenario specified when the session was initiated
parameters.help_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID used to uniquely associate this interaction. For a text session, it is the text- identifier returned when the session is initiated. For web voice, it is the ws- identifier. For real number outbound call tests, it is the test- identifier. Subsequent calls must use the actual returned value
parameters.help_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The JSON array string of additional input events. Supports DTMF key press events (dataType=DTMF, dtmf is the key content), Silence events (dataType=Silence), and RuntimePrompts events (dataType=RuntimePrompts, prompts is the prompt text, persistent specifies whether to persist). For example, a silence event is [{"dataType":"Silence"}]. This parameter is optional when no additional events are present
parameters.help_zh: 附加输入事件的JSON数组字符串。支持DTMF按键事件（dataType=DTMF、dtmf为按键内容）、Silence静默事件（dataType=Silence）和RuntimePrompts运行时提示事件（dataType=RuntimePrompts、prompts为提示文本、persistent为是否持久化）。例如静默事件为[{"dataType":"Silence"}]；无附加事件时可不传
parameters.name: extras

parameters.example: 我想咨询一下业务办理流程。
parameters.help_en: The text input content of the user for the current round. For normal conversations, pass the actual text of the user. Events such as key presses or silence can be passed through Extras. The processing method is determined by the scenario and the engine
parameters.help_zh: 本轮用户的文本输入内容。普通对话传入用户实际文本；按键或静默等事件可通过Extras传递，处理方式由场景和引擎决定
parameters.name: utterance

schema.description_en: The business response of this API operation. Code=OK indicates success, and Data contains the corresponding business result. In case of an error, troubleshoot by combining Message and Params. For the text interface, each SSE data event carries a response object of this structure
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应。Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果，错误时结合Message及Params排查。文本接口每个SSE data事件承载一个此结构的响应对象
schema.example: {"RequestId":"AAAAAAAA-BBBB-4CCC-8DDD-EEEEEEEEEEEE","HttpStatusCode":200,"Message":"","Code":"OK","Data":{"Answer":"好的，我为您介绍一下办理流程。","StreamEnd":true,"SessionId":"text-11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","StreamId":"1","StartTime":1794560400000,"EndTime":1794560400123,"ControlParamsList":[{"Type":"Voice"}],"Extras":{"DebugInfo":"{}"}},"Params":[]}

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. OK indicates success. When an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified in this operation
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The robot reply, round ID, time, and control instructions carried by the current SSE event. A single round may contain multiple events
Data.description_zh: 当前SSE事件承载的机器人回复、轮次标识、时间和控制指令；一个轮次可能有多个事件
Data.example: {"Answer":"好的，我为您介绍一下办理流程。","StreamEnd":true,"SessionId":"text-11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","StreamId":"1","StartTime":1794560400000,"EndTime":1794560400123,"ControlParamsList":[{"Type":"Voice"}],"Extras":{"DebugInfo":"{}"}}

Answer.description_en: The robot reply text in the current streaming event. It may be returned across multiple SSE events, or it may be empty in the end event or debug event. Do not equate the absence of text with session failure. Whether the content is incremental or cumulative is determined by the output convention of the conversation engine. The current general callback directly forwards the engine content
Answer.description_zh: 当前流式事件中的机器人回复文本。可能按多个SSE事件返回，也可能在结束事件或调试事件中为空；不要将缺少文本等同于会话失败。内容是增量还是累计由对话引擎输出约定决定，当前通用回调直接转发引擎内容
Answer.example: 好的，我为您介绍一下办理流程。

ControlParamsList.description_en: The robot control instructions attached to this reply. The current POP structure only expands the instruction Type and does not add other instruction fields in this document. When no control instruction is generated, the text service supplements a Voice type instruction
ControlParamsList.description_zh: 本次回复随附的机器人控制指令。当前POP结构只展开指令Type，不在本次文档中新增其他指令字段；未产生控制指令时，文本服务会补充Voice类型指令

items.description_en: A robot control instruction. The currently declared public field is Type. Whether the specific action is executed is determined by the caller and the business link
items.description_zh: 一条机器人控制指令，当前已声明的公开字段为Type。具体动作是否执行由调用方和业务链路决定

Type.description_en: The values declared in the control instruction type include Voice (voice reply), HangUp (hang up), Transfer (transfer), GatherDtmf (collect key presses), and SendSms (send SMS). This update supplements the previously omitted SendSms without changing the backend structure or runtime enumeration constraints
Type.description_zh: 已在控制指令类型中声明的值包括Voice（语音回复）、HangUp（挂断）、Transfer（转接）、GatherDtmf（收集按键）和SendSms（发送短信）。本次补充原说明遗漏的SendSms，不改变后端结构或运行时枚举约束

EndTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the current streaming reply callback event, in milliseconds. It is generated based on the current callback time. It may also be returned when StreamEnd is false. It should not be directly interpreted as the end time of the entire session or call
EndTime.description_zh: 当前流式回复回调事件的Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。由当前回调时间生成；在StreamEnd=false时也可能返回，不应将其直接解释为整个会话或通话结束时间
EndTime.title_en: 当前回复事件发送时间
EndTime.title_zh: 当前回复事件发送时间

Extras.description_en: The extension information object attached to the robot reply, which is different from the JSON event array of the request parameter Extras. The current POP expands the DebugInfo field. Whether it is actually returned depends on the engine used and the current round of reply
Extras.description_zh: 机器人回复附带的扩展信息对象，与请求参数Extras的JSON事件数组不同。当前POP展开DebugInfo字段；实际是否返回取决于所使用的引擎和本轮回复

DebugInfo.description_en: The debug information returned by the conversation engine, which is a JSON string. It is returned only when the engine provides and obtains the debug information, and may be returned with supplementary events after the reply ends. The internal structure is determined by the engine. The example empty object string does not declare any fixed debug fields
DebugInfo.description_zh: 对话引擎返回的调试信息，为JSON字符串。仅在引擎提供且取得调试信息时返回，可能随回复结束后的补充事件返回；内部结构由引擎决定，示例空对象字符串不声明任何固定调试字段

SessionId.description_en: The session ID used to uniquely associate this interaction. For a text session, it is the text- identifier returned when the session is initiated. For web voice, it is the ws- identifier. For real number outbound call tests, it is the test- identifier. Subsequent calls must use the actual returned value
SessionId.description_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值

StartTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp recorded when the streaming reply callback is entered for the first time in the current round, in milliseconds. Subsequent events in the current round use this time. It is not the session creation time, nor is it an update time in the general sense
StartTime.description_zh: 本轮第一次进入流式回复回调时记录的Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。本轮后续事件沿用该时间；不是会话创建时间，也不是一般意义的更新时间
StartTime.title_en: 本轮首个回复事件时间
StartTime.title_zh: 本轮首个回复事件时间

StreamEnd.description_en: Indicates whether the streaming output of the current reply round has ended. A value of true indicates that the streaming output has ended and the service has completed the corresponding SSE response. A value of false indicates that there may still be subsequent events in the current round. This field does not indicate that the entire session or voice call has ended
StreamEnd.description_zh: true表示当前回复轮次的流式输出已结束，服务完成对应SSE响应；false表示本轮仍可能有后续事件。该字段不代表整个会话或语音通话已结束
StreamEnd.title_en: 当前轮次响应流是否结束
StreamEnd.title_zh: 当前轮次响应流是否结束

StreamId.description_en: The ID of the conversation round to which the current robot reply belongs. A single round of reply may contain multiple streaming events. The text session context starts from 0 and increments upon subsequent Dialogue calls. The actual value returned by the engine shall prevail
StreamId.description_zh: 本次机器人回复所属的对话轮次标识。同一轮回复可包含多个流式事件；文本会话上下文从0开始，并在后续Dialogue调用时递增。应以引擎实际返回值为准

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return is 200. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check Code. You cannot determine that the call is successful solely based on the presence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error description. It is usually empty or not returned upon success. A fixed text cannot be required upon success. Upon failure, it provides an error description to assist in troubleshooting. Combine it with Code and Params to understand the cause of the error. The example shows an error message when the instance does not exist (corresponding to the Code NotExists.InstanceId) and is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为实例不存在时的错误消息（对应Code为NotExists.InstanceId），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The parameter list used for the localized display of error messages. It is not a scenario variable or business result. A normal successful response is usually an empty array. When an error occurs, parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content is determined by the current error. The example InstanceId only demonstrates a possible field name and does not indicate that this value is returned for every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to associate and troubleshoot this POP request. The value in the response corresponds to the current request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, and the caller does not need to fill in the system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
